name: parkscomputing-site
description: Shortcode completion, hover and problems for the site's Markdown, from the site engine's own language server.

parkscomputingSite.server.description: The command that starts the site's language server, and its arguments. ${workspaceFolder} is the open folder, which should be the site's wwwroot. With the engine built locally it can be ["dotnet", "path/to/ParksComputing.Engine.dll", "lsp"].
